title: Incorrect usage of seeds in pseudo-random number generator in the Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could…
description: A vulnerability in the Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware involves incorrect usage of seeds in its pseudo-random number generator. This flaw could allow a malicious hypervisor or migration agent to import a forged guest context, potentially leading to loss of confidentiality of derived guest keys. The issue is classified as medium severity with a CVSS score of 6. No affected versions or patches are specified in the available data.
